rule: Proposed edits inside documented inter-unit silent gaps; not presented as verified speech boundaries or independently measured silence.

edit_intervals.primary: One adult worker in neutral office/home context; calendar indicates long working week and a phone represents weekend reachability; no fabricated readable messages.
edit_intervals.camera: Static, one modest reframing; avoid invented employer or boss.
edit_intervals.illustrative_character: human-neutral; optional dog character NOT mandated

edit_intervals.primary: Same worker and same calendar, with one limited personal boundary gesture; external schedule visibly remains unchanged. No new story or boss character.
edit_intervals.camera: Maintain spatial continuity; reveal difference through one restrained change.
edit_intervals.illustrative_character: human-neutral; optional dog character NOT mandated

edit_intervals.primary: A modest clearly attributed WHO source reference plus minimal original typography of narration's accurate classification, NOT a simulated WHO webpage or copyrighted screenshot.
edit_intervals.camera: Quiet hold with one restrained emphasis; no fake clinical chart.
edit_intervals.illustrative_character: human-neutral; optional dog character NOT mandated

edit_intervals.primary: Return to same worker and calendar; personal coping actions change on one side, while workload, deadlines and always-on expectation remain. No invented workload statistics.
edit_intervals.camera: One continuous compositional transformation instead of presentation panels.
edit_intervals.illustrative_character: human-neutral; optional dog character NOT mandated

requirements: No invented dialogue, screenshot, clinical diagnosis or archival artifact
Voiceover unchanged; subtitles only from verified SRT
No subtitle/camera starts before its supporting sentence
WHO source link/citation must be independently checked; screen capture forbidden until rights cleared
Every exported frame must pass eight PR #4 QA checks
No production model calls until hash approvals and backend exist
